additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390865-DC/Si-D/UAE- [MP / R5 170001907 ]- HMI display issue. CRM:01282000651
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Kindly perform below steps and let us know the update.
1.Please reboot the charger.
2.You will need to change the DP cable and update Display controller. Please replace the DP cable with a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part and NOT any other DP cable). Also please route the DP cable as far as possible from routers, R&D found out that this component is affecting the EMC performance.
3.Also please check the 24VDC power supply. it should be set to 25VDC.
Attaching a document in which all the steps are mentioned related to black screen.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavy Gurav
